name: Martin Heidegger
shortBio: Ontologist who revived the question of Being; analyzed human existence as Dasein ('Being-in-the-world') oriented toward death.
centralQuestion: What is the meaning of Being, and how has Western metaphysics forgotten it?

keyWorks.title: Being and Time
keyWorks.description: Heidegger's fundamental ontology: analyzing human existence as Dasein ('Being-in-the-world') oriented toward death.
